# UChooseIt.us

> UChooseIt is a VIP discount membership program for consumers in the United States. One membership, over 1 million deals, up to 50% off on dining, travel, shopping, and entertainment.

## About

UChooseIt.us is a private members-only discount network that gives families and individuals access to exclusive savings at over 1 million locations across the United States. Members pay $47.99/year (less than $4/month) and unlock permanent discounts — not one-time coupons — at major national brands and local businesses alike.

The platform is powered by the My Deals app (500,000+ downloads on iOS and Android), available in 10 languages including Spanish. Discounts are GPS-enabled, so members always find savings nearby.

Average member savings: $2,000+ per year (2024 data).

## Membership Categories

- **Shopping** (175,000+ locations): Technology, fashion, home, health, fitness — brands like Lenovo, Samsung, Chewy.com, Jiffy Lube
- **Travel** (850,000+ locations): Hotels, car rentals, flights, cruises — Wyndham, Avis, Alamo, Carnival, Disney Cruises, Stay America
- **Dining** (50,000+ locations): National chains and local restaurants — Papa John's, Subway, Burger King, Domino's, Dairy Queen, Panda Express
- **Entertainment** (50,000+ locations): Theme parks, movies, golf, museums — Disney, Universal, Six Flags, Cinemark, Topgolf, Lego

## Key Facts

- Price: $47.99/year ($3.99/month equivalent)
- Deals: 1,000,000+ locations across the US
- Average savings: $2,000+/year
- App: My Deals (iOS + Android), 500,000+ downloads
- Languages: 10 (including English and Spanish)
- Guarantee: 7-day money-back, cancel anytime
- Privacy: No data selling, private discount network
- Support: (888) 556-2393 | support@uchooseit.us

## B2B Partnership Program

UChooseIt also offers a white-label discount platform for organizations that want to provide savings to their audience under their own brand.

### Partnership Models
- **Revenue Share (RSM):** Zero upfront cost, earn 30% per membership sold, automated payouts
- **Bulk/Enterprise:** Fixed annual rate, unlimited users per tier, ideal for employee benefits

### Ideal For
- Companies rewarding customer loyalty
- Employers offering modern benefits
- Nonprofits creating recurring revenue for donors
- Professional associations and alumni communities

### How It Works
1. Strategy Call — Discuss goals and choose the right model
2. Integration Plan — Marketing assets and technical onboarding
3. Live Demo — Walkthrough of the platform and dashboard
4. Community Launch — Go live and start delivering savings
